_documentation.purpose: Runs the coupled convergence benchmark experiment or benchmark.
_documentation.authority: Values in this file are authoritative for its runner. A sweep value overrides the corresponding base-simulation value only for that named case; effective values are recorded in summary.json.

fields.simulation_config: Base production simulation JSON built before this runner applies documented experiment controls.
fields.convergence.tolerance: Numerical or physical acceptance tolerance for tolerance.
fields.convergence.prediction_window: Recent residual values used to estimate convergence behavior.
fields.convergence.reasonable_iterations: Iteration count treated as acceptable when scoring a benchmark.
fields.adaptive_relaxation.enabled: Enables this model or output feature.
fields.adaptive_controller.enabled: Enables this model or output feature.
fields.adaptive_controller.component_prediction: Iteration count treated as acceptable when scoring a benchmark.
Residual-reduction ratio above which progress is stalled.
fields.adaptive_controller.adaptation.electrica: Numerical or physical acceptance tolerance for electrical factor.
fields.adaptive_controller.adaptation.tdgl_max_: Configures tdgl max normalized timestep factor.
fields.adaptive_controller.bounds.electrical_to: Numerical or physical acceptance tolerance for electrical min.
Numerical or physical acceptance tolerance for electrical max.
fields.adaptive_controller.bounds.tdgl_max_norm: Configures tdgl max normalized timestep min.
Configures tdgl max normalized timestep max.
fields.adaptive_controller.retry.max_restarts_p: Upper limit for restarts per timestep.
fields.adaptive_controller.behavior.adapt_one_c: Enables or disables adapt one component.
fields.adaptive_controller.behavior.adapt_two_c: Enables or disables adapt two components.
fields.adaptive_controller.behavior.reduce_dt_w: Enables or disables reduce dt when all components problematic.
fields.adaptive_controller.behavior.reduce_sigm: Enables or disables reduce sigma only for oscillation.
fields.adaptive_controller.behavior.retain_succ: Enables or disables retain successful parameters.
fields.initial_conditions.uniform_psi_one: Enables or disables uniform psi one.
fields.initial_conditions.initial_tdgl_max_norm: Configures initial tdgl max normalized timestep.
fields.thermal.bath_temperature: Thermal-reservoir temperature toward which the film relaxes.
fields.thermal.thermal_relaxation_rate: Linear heat-removal coefficient coupling the film to its bath.
fields.electrical.voltage_left: Potential imposed at the left transport boundary.
fields.electrical.voltage_right: Potential imposed at the right transport boundary.
fields.electrical.inner_tolerance_policy: Numerical or physical acceptance tolerance for inner policy.
fields.electrical.inner_tolerance_factor: Numerical or physical acceptance tolerance for inner factor.
fields.external_heat.enabled: Enables this model or output feature.
fields.output.directory: Base output directory; runners reserve a numbered sibling if it already exists.
fields.numerical_safeguards.parameter_change_re: Numerical or physical acceptance tolerance for parameter change relative.
